concerns.text: The primary outcome (UPDRS III longitudinal slope) is not present in any verified dataset (see research.md). The plan proceeds under the assumption that this variable will be supplied later, which means the core research question cannot be answered with the currently available data.
No power analysis is provided. With ~200 patients (or as few as 30 after filtering) and testing hundreds of taxa, the study may be under‑powered to detect modest associations after BH correction.

The plan applies CLR transformation after dropping taxa with all‑zero counts, but does not specify how zero counts within retained taxa are handled (e.g., pseudo‑count addition). This can affect construct validity of the CLR‑based slopes.
Confound adjustment includes only age, sex, and levodopa dose. Important microbiome‑related confounders (diet, antibiotic use, BMI, batch effects) are omitted, risking biased interaction estimates.

The permutation scheme shuffles patient IDs while preserving visit order, which is appropriate for the LME interaction but does not account for potential temporal autocorrelation within a patient’s trajectory; this could inflate type I error.
